title: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Starting population
scenes.purpose: Show the field, both agent populations unlinked, the legend and the rule before any interaction.
visuals: Field grid wipes in left to right
9 idea circles and 14 builder triangles appear in a stagger
Dashed radius r ring on the first idea to receive a link (single-agent rule inset)

beats.development: Field, population, legend and rule text reveal
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Radius r ring pops around the focus idea to explain the rule

scenes.title: Interaction under one rule
scenes.purpose: Builders move toward the nearest idea they can sense. A link grows when the distance falls below r, and linked agents form systems with soft halos.
visuals: Link lines grow from builder to idea
Pale halos mark agents that belong to a system
Bars move from '1' to '2–3' and '4+'; link and system counters come from the same run

beats.development: First links form; isolated agents drop from 23 to about 8
Shared builders merge ideas into larger systems; the ring fades; the run settles at 2 / 9 / 12

scenes.title: Resulting distribution
scenes.purpose: Hold on the settled field and the distribution so the result can be read.
visuals: Bars ×2 / ×9 / ×12 with the 'agents by system size' axis

findings: The starting population is visible about 0.3 s before movement begins, as the style requires
The interaction settles in the baked run at about 2.0 s, before the 2.3 s hold
justifiedHolds: 0.7 s final hold to read the distribution bars and counters

notes: Every frame is computed from timeline time, using baked simulation steps with interpolation, so seeking in any order gives the same frame
